title: Ground Vehicle System Center (GVSC) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO)
description: The United States Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Ground Vehicle Systems Center (GVSC), located in Warren, Michigan, is the U.S Armed Forces� research and development facility for advanced technology in ground systems. The U.S Army DEVCOM is a major subordinate command of the U.S Army Futures Command (AFC) and shares its facilities with the U.S Army Tank- Automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM). GVSC�s current technology focus areas include Power and Mobility, Autonomous Systems, Force Projection, Survivability & Protection, Electronics and Architecture, Cyber Engineering and Software Integration, Human Machine Integration, Advance Manufacturing and Modeling, and Simulation and Prototyping. Ground Vehicle Systems Center (GVSC) seeks to accelerate the delivery and sustainment of Ground System Capabilities to their partners to ensure early identification of warfighter needs. GVSC aims to develop systems that are resistive to immediate obsolescence and overmatch. GVSC will invest in the technologies, competencies, and organic infrastructure that will achieve the exponential capability offset that will guarantee future dominance in the ground domain. As a result of this CSO, GVSC seeks to award the following, but is not limited to: FAR contracts under FAR Part 12, Commercial Procedures; or non?FAR agreements such as transaction agreements under 10 U.S.C 4022; and Cooperative Agreements under 31 U.S.C. 6305 for GVSC and/or its customers that are directly relevant to enhancing the effectiveness of development, integration, demonstration, and sustainment of ground vehicle systems capabilities to support Army modernization priorities and improve readiness. This CSO may result in awards to proposals for innovative, commercial technologies through multi?phased, competitive processes throughout 2029.

The U.S Army DEVCOM is a major subordinate command of the U.S Army Futures Command (AFC) and shares its facilities with the U.S Army Tank- Automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM). GVSC�s current technology focus areas include Power and Mobility, Autonomous Systems, Force Projection, Survivability & Protection, Electronics and Architecture, Cyber Engineering and Software Integration, Human Machine Integration, Advance Manufacturing and Modeling, and Simulation and Prototyping. Ground Vehicle Systems Center (GVSC) seeks to accelerate the delivery and sustainment of Ground System Capabilities to their partners to ensure early identification of warfighter needs. GVSC aims to develop systems that are resistive to immediate obsolescence and overmatch. GVSC will invest in the technologies, competencies, and organic infrastructure that will achieve the exponential capability offset that will guarantee future dominance in the ground domain. As a result of this CSO, GVSC seeks to award the following, but is not limited to: FAR contracts under FAR Part 12, Commercial Procedures; or non?FAR agreements such as transaction agreements under 10 U.S.C 4022; and Cooperative Agreements under 31 U.S.C. 6305 for GVSC and/or its customers that are directly relevant to enhancing the effectiveness of development, integration, demonstration, and sustainment of ground vehicle systems capabilities to support Army modernization priorities and improve readiness. This CSO may result in awards to proposals for innovative, commercial technologies through multi?phased, competitive processes throughout 2029.

AMENDMENT 7: FAMM-P BAR Risk Reduction (Closed Spiral) 1.0 OVERVIEW & ACQUISITION STRATEGY Based on market intelligence and capabilities assessed from the Request for Information (RFI) posted on 17 April 2026 and Industry Day on 6 May 2026, the Government is executing a targeted acquisition approach for the Family of Affordable Mass Missile Palletized (FAMM-P) Beyond Adversary�s Reach (BAR) effort. The Government is currently executing a 3-month Risk Reduction effort to finalize design feasibility and inform the baseline System Requirements Document (SRD). In accordance with the ADRR CSO User�s Guide procedures for a Closed Spiral (Direct to Step-Two), participation in this specific Risk Reduction Spiral is strictly limited to the highly capable vendors identified and down-selected from the 17 April 2026 RFI and 6 May 2026 Industry Day. 2.0 SOLICITATION DOCUMENT DISTRIBUTION Because this is a Closed Spiral and the solicitation package contains Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) restricted as FEDCON, the Government will not post the Commercial Solutions for Proposal (CSP) or technical attachments to SAM.gov. For Pre-Selected Vendors: The Government will distribute the CSP and all associated technical documents directly to the pre-approved vendors via DoD SAFE. Vendors who were down-selected from the market intelligence should monitor their provided Points of Contact emails for the DoD SAFE drop-off link. For All Other Vendors: Unsolicited proposals or requests for the CUI package from vendors not pre-selected for this Risk Reduction will not be accepted or evaluated. 3.0 FUTURE COMPETITIVE OPPORTUNITIES Important Note to Industry: The Government is currently evaluating the potential for a separate, overarching Development Prototype effort following the conclusion of this FAMM-P BAR Risk Reduction. Should the Government obtain the necessary approvals and funding to proceed with a subsequent Development Prototype, it will be competitively awarded. Participation in this current Risk Reduction is NOT a prerequisite for competing in any potential future efforts. All interested vendors, including those not participating in this current spiral, will have the opportunity to compete if and when a follow-on solicitation is publicly released.

Kanta-Hämeen aluehallitus on 22.4.2024 § 12 päättänyt käynnistää kotihoitoa täydentävän hankinnan hyvivnvointialueella. Hankinnan tavoitteet: - Hankinta täydentää omaa palvelutuotantoa ja varmistaa asiakkaiden kotihoidon palvelujen saatavuuden - Kevennetään oman henkilöstöön kohdistuvaa työpainetta - Ostopalvelusopimukset saadaan voimaan mahdollisimman nopeasti - Hankinnalla ei sitouduta ostamaan tiettyä määrää, vaan se mahdollistaa ostot tarpeiden mukaan - Palvelu tuotetaan kustannustehokkaasti. Laatu ja vaikuttavuus vastaa tilaajan palvelukuvausta - Edistetään monituottajuutta - Hillitään kotihoidon kustannuksia, edistetään markkinoiden toimivuutta ja kilpailua - Edistetään alueiden elinvoimaisuutta - Hankintamenetelmällä hyväksytään joustavasti uusia palveluntuottajia sopimuskumppaneiksi koko sopimuskauden ajan Kotihoidon hankintoja varten Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue avaa tällä osallistumishakemuksella joustavan toimittajarekisterin, johon hyväksytään palveluntuottajat jatkuvalla haulla koko toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon ajan 17.6.2029 saakka. Joustavan toimittajarekisterin kautta voidaan pyytää tarjouksia erilaisiin kotihoidon palveluihin toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon aikana. Kyseessä on kaksivaiheinen hankintatapa, joka on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteenä "Joustavan toimittajarekisterin periaatteet". Tilaaja tulee avaamaan ensimmäisen sisäisen tarjouspyynnön toimittajarekisterin sisällä mahdollisimman pian hankintavaiheeseen siirtymisen 17.6.2024 jälkeen.

title: France – Motor vehicles – Système d'acquisition dynamique pour l'acquisition de véhicules légers et utilitaires neufs et d'occasion
description: La Communauté d'Agglomération de Béthune-Bruay, Artois Lys Romane (CABBALR) souhaite promouvoir l'économie circulaire afin de répondre aux objectifs de la loi AGEC en matière d'acquisition de véhicules issus du réemploi ou de la réutilisation. Dans cette perspective, la CABBALR prévoit de lancer plusieurs consultations afin d'acquérir des véhicules d'occasion. Toutefois, certaines consultations concernent des véhicules neufs, dans le cas où la disponibilité des véhicules d'occasions ne serait pas satisfaisante (pas de véhicules disponibles à la vente / technicité spécifique des besoins, etc) Le SAD permet à la collectivité de disposer tout au long de l'année d'une capacité d'achat performante, ce pourquoi la CABBALR s'est portée sur cette technique d'achat. Le présent système d'acquisition dynamique porte donc sur l'achat de véhicules d'occasions et neufs. Ce besoin a été décomposé en 4 catégories : catégorie n°1 Véhicules légers d'occasion /// catégorie n°2 Véhicules utilitaires légers d'occasion /// catégorie n°3 Véhicules légers neufs /// catégorie n°4 Véhicules utilitaires légers neufs. Il permettra pendant une durée de 4 ans de solliciter, auprès des entreprises agréées, une offre pour l'achat de véhicules d'occasions et neufs. Ces consultations déboucheront sur des « marchés spécifiques ». L'examen des candidatures portera sur les capacités techniques, financières et professionnelles du candidat à exécuter les prestations. Le pouvoir adjudicateur cible des vendeurs professionnels de véhicules selon leur catégorie. Les candidatures répondant aux critères de sélection figurant dans le règlement de la consultation seront admises dans le système d'acquisition dynamique pour toute sa période de validité. Le pouvoir adjudicateur notifie via le profil acheteur sa décision d'agrément ou de rejet de la candidature. Les candidats agréés sont recensés sur une liste conservée par l'acheteur. Une fois intégrés au SAD, les candidats seront dès lors invités à soumissionner à chaque consultation lancée pour les marchés spécifiques de la catégorie à laquelle ils ont été agréés. Le nombre de candidats n'est pas limité. La date limite de remise des candidatures initiales est fixée au 11 août 2025 à 12h00.

Hankinnan tavoitteet: - Hankinta täydentää omaa palvelutuotantoa ja varmistaa asiakkaiden kotihoidon palvelujen saatavuuden - Kevennetään oman henkilöstöön kohdistuvaa työpainetta - Ostopalvelusopimukset saadaan voimaan mahdollisimman nopeasti - Hankinnalla ei sitouduta ostamaan tiettyä määrää, vaan se mahdollistaa ostot tarpeiden mukaan - Palvelu tuotetaan kustannustehokkaasti. Laatu ja vaikuttavuus vastaa tilaajan palvelukuvausta - Edistetään monituottajuutta - Hillitään kotihoidon kustannuksia, edistetään markkinoiden toimivuutta ja kilpailua - Edistetään alueiden elinvoimaisuutta - Hankintamenetelmällä hyväksytään joustavasti uusia palveluntuottajia sopimuskumppaneiksi koko sopimuskauden ajan Kotihoidon hankintoja varten Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue avaa tällä osallistumishakemuksella joustavan toimittajarekisterin, johon hyväksytään palveluntuottajat jatkuvalla haulla koko toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon ajan 17.6.2029 saakka. Joustavan toimittajarekisterin kautta voidaan pyytää tarjouksia erilaisiin kotihoidon palveluihin toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon aikana. Kyseessä on kaksivaiheinen hankintatapa, joka on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteenä "Joustavan toimittajarekisterin periaatteet". Tilaaja tulee avaamaan ensimmäisen sisäisen tarjouspyynnön toimittajarekisterin sisällä mahdollisimman pian hankintavaiheeseen siirtymisen 17.6.2024 jälkeen.

title: Bulgaria – Dressings; clip, suture, ligature supplies – Доставка на хирургичен шевен материал
description: Настоящата динамична система за покупки се създава за период от 48 месеца с цел обезпечаване на доставки на хирургичен шевен материал за нуждите на „СБАЛАГ - Майчин дом" ЕАД. В рамките на динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) ще бъдат възлагани обществени поръчки чрез ограничени процедури за периодични доставки на хирургичен шевен материал. Хирургичните консумативи са подробно описани в приложената първоначална техническа спецификация, със собствен пореден номер, описание на минималните изисквания, единична мярка и прогнозно количество. Посочените в приложената техническа спецификация видове хирургични консумативи , както и прогнозните количества могат да бъдат променяни чрез добавянето на нови видове хирургичен шевен материал или чрез промяна на прогнозните количества при възлагането на всяка конкретна обществена поръчка, в рамките на създадената ДСП. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на 48 месеца и в този период възложителят отправя покани до включените в ДСП кандидати за представяне на оферти за всяка конкретна ограничена процедура за доставка на хирургичен шевен материал. Срокът на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените процедури в рамките на ДСП е за период от 24 месеца.

title: Voluntary Intermodal Sealift Agreement (VISA) - 2024 Renewal
description: The attached Voluntary Intermodal Sealift Agreement (VISA) solicitation and attachments are posted in order to execute the next iteration of VISA contracts. These contingency contracts implement VISA as defined in the Federal Register dated 29 October 2014. VISA provides for contingency sealift services that may arise in any part of the world. The general scope of services under this contract includes the provision of ocean transportation charter for worldwide port-to-port ocean movements and related intermodal movements, infrastructure, services, and management expertise. VISA participants shall provide basic services, as outlined in the Terms and Conditions, including guaranteed capacity commitments, in the event of VISA activation, for use during DoD contingency operations. For this iteration of VISA, the Period of Performance for the Base Period is 1 October 2024 � 30 September 2029 and Option Period 1 is 1 October 2029 � 30 September 2034. The VISA solicitation is open for enrollment from 27 June 2024 to 30 September 2034. VISA participants receive priority for peacetime DoD cargo and no low dollar minimally funded task order will be executed to bind the parties to this VISA contingency contract and the vessel capacity commitments within. Current VISA Participants: In July 2024, USTRANSCOM-AQ will begin reaching out to all current VISA participants via email to confirm if they want to remain enrolled in the program. If the participant chooses to remain in VISA, USTRANSCOM-AQ will provide each participant their Attachment 1 and 2(s) from the previous iteration of the contract to identify any changes to vessel commitments. All Attachment 2s will need to be refilled out/submitted to USTRANSCOM-AQ regardless of vessel changes as we have removed 2 pricing methodologies from the previous iteration. If vessel changes are necessary, participant will update their Attachment 1 and send through the review/signature coordination process with the (Maritime Administration) MARAD and USTRANSCOM. If there are no vessel changes, USTRANSCOM-AQ will update the contract number on the Attachment 1 and include it in the conformed copy of the contract. When Attachment 1 and 2(s) are finalized, USTRANSCOM-AQ will provide the VISA contingency contract for the participant to sign and return to USTRANSCOM-AQ. USTRANSCOM-AQ will sign, execute the VISA contingency contract, and provide to participant for their records. New VISA Participants: All new participants will need to enroll through the MARAD website at: https://www.maritime.dot.gov/strategic-sealift/office-ship-operations/visa-enrollment-package After MARAD approval, AQ will work with each participant to execute all necessary documents for contract execution. We look forward to working with all current and new VISA participants!

title: Bulgaria – Medical equipments – Периодична доставка на резервни части и сервизно обслужване на различни видове медицинска апаратура
description: Предмет на Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) е Периодична доставка на резервни части и сервизно обслужване на различни видове медицинска апаратура, както следва: Медицинска апаратура Siemens Медицинска апаратура KARL STORZ Медицинска апаратура Olimpus Хипер и хипо барни камери Анестезиологична и реанимационна медицинска апаратура Mindray Медицинска апаратура ехографски апарати Mindray Медицинска рентгенова апаратура Медицинска апаратура за хемодиализа Б.Браун Авитум Медицинска апаратура за образна диагностика General Electric Медицинска утразвукова апаратура General Electric Медицинска апаратура Carl Zaiss 5. Условия за услугите/доставките • Посещения след повикване за диагностициране на повреда/и; • Посещения след повикване за отстраняване на възникнали повреди, извършване на необходимите ремонти и тестове, както и софтуерен ъпдейт (където е приложимо) за осигуряване на пълната функционалност на апаратурата, съобразно изискванията на производителя; • Доставка, при необходимост на резервни части, след отправена писмена заявка от Възложителя; • Монтаж на заявената резервна част и пускане в експлоатация на апаратурата. Доставките на резервни части ще са периодични, и ще се извършват само при необходимост, след предварителна писмена заявка от Възложителя, в зависимост от неговите потребности. Договорът, в частта му за периодичните доставки на резервни части, ще бъде сключен на посочената прогнозна стойност. За срока на договора Възложителят не е задължен да реализира пълния размер на уговорената сума, а само толкова колкото е заявеното, доставено и монтирано. В изготвената Техническата спецификация - Приложение №1, са посочени видовете медицинска апаратура. Посочените в Техническата спецификация различни видове медицинска апаратура, е възможно да бъдат променяни, в зависимост от конкретните нужди на Възложителя, чрез добавянето на нови, при възлагането на всяка конкретна обществена поръчка (ограничена процедура), в рамките на създадената Динамична система за покупки, за срока на действието й. При възлагането на всяка конкретна обществена поръчка (ограничена процедура), ще бъдат подробно описани резервните части за съответната медицинска апаратура.

title: Poland – Personal computers – Dostawa sprzętu informatycznego z oprogramowaniem i urządzeniami peryferyjnymi
description: Niniejsze ogłoszenie dotyczy ustanowienia Dynamicznego Systemu Zakupów (dalej DSZ), przy uwzględnieniu założeń: 1. Przedmiotem zamówień sukcesywnie udzielanych w ramach DSZ będą dostawy sprzętu informatycznego. 2. Zamawiający szacuje całkowitą ilość zamawianego asortymentu na około: 1) Monitory komputerowe – 1600 szt. 2) Komputery PC wraz z systemem operacyjnym – 1200 szt. 3) Komputery AiO wraz z systemem operacyjnym – 500 szt. 4) Komputery przenośne wraz z systemem operacyjnym – 500 szt. 5) Licencje dostępowe (DEVICE CAL) – 2200 szt. 6) Skanery dokumentowe – 400 szt. 7) Urządzenia wielofunkcyjne – 200 szt. 8) Drukarki – 600 szt. 3. Zamawiający przewiduje udzielić 1 większe zamówienie każdego roku (ok. 400 szt. monitorów, 300 szt. komputerów, 100 szt. komputerów przenośnych, 400 szt. licencji dostępowych) oraz 1-2 mniejsze zamówienia w ciągu trwania każdego z kwartałów. Udzielanie zamówień będzie uzależnione od potrzeb Zamawiającego oraz posiadanych środków. 4. Na potwierdzenie, że oferowany sprzęt informatyczny spełnia wymagania Zamawiającego, Wykonawca będzie zobowiązany złożyć wraz z ofertą przedmiotowe środki dowodowe. Rodzaj dokumentów zostanie każdorazowo określony w zaproszeniu do składania ofert. 5. Jeżeli Wykonawca nie złoży w/w środków dowodowych lub złożone w/w środki dowodowe będą niekompletne, Zamawiający, zgodnie z art. 107 Ustawy Pzp, wezwie do ich złożenia lub uzupełnienia. 6. Zamawiający może żądać wyjaśnień dotyczących złożonych przedmiotowych środków dowodowych Zamawiający nie przewiduje wizji lokalnej. 7. Zamawiający nie przewiduje udzielenia zamówień o których mowa w art. 214 ust. 1 pkt. 8 Ustawy Pzp. 8. Zamawiający nie przewiduje wizji lokalnej. 9.Realizacja zamówienia nie wymaga zatrudnienia na podstawie umowy o pracę. 10. Zamawiający nie wymaga zatrudnienia osób o których mowa w art. 96 ust. 2 pkt.2 Ustawy Pzp. 11. Zamawiający nie stawia wymagań dot. możliwości ubiegania się o udzielenie zamówienia wyłącznie przez wykonawców, o których mowa w art. 94 Ustawy Pzp. 12. Zamawiający nie dokonuje zastrzeżenia o obowiązku osobistego wykonania przez Wykonawcę kluczowych części zamówienia. 13. Przewidywany okres obowiązywania DSZ: do 29.06.2029 r.

title: Finland – Repair and maintenance services of medical and precision equipment – Lääkinnällisten laitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut sekä niiden varaosat ja tarvikkeet 2024-2029 (DPS)
description: Istekki Oy pyytää osallistumishakemuksia lääkinnällisten laitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut sekä niiden varaosat ja tarvikkeet hankintoja varten perustettavaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään (DPS). Istekki Oy perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän Istekin ylläpitovastuulla olevien lääkinnällisten laitteiden korjaus-, huolto- ja varaosakilpailutuksia varten tukemaan Istekki Oy:n omaa palvelutuotantoa. Istekki Oy tuottaa ko. palvelua omistaja-asiakkailleen, joita ovat esimerkiksi hyvinvointialueet Suomessa. Perustettava dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä jakautuu seuraaviin osa-alueisiin joiden sisällä suoritetaan osa-aluekohtaiset kilpailutukset dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassaolon aikana: • Osa-alue 1: Perusterveydenhuollon laitteet • Osa-alue 2: Erikoissairaanhoidon laitteet • Osa-alue 3: Välinehuollon laitteet • Osa-alue 4: Laboratoriolaitteet • Osa-alue 5: Hyvinvointialueiden toimipisteiden käytössä olevat apuvälineet • Osa-alue 6: Kuvantamislaitteet • Osa-alue 7: Huollon mittalaitteet Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voivat hakea Tarjoajaksi kaikki sellaiset ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät ESPD-lomakkeella ilmoitetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytään kaikki Tarjoajat, jotka täyttävät asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Kaikki kiinnostuneet tarjoajat voivat koko dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston ajan pyytää oikeutta osallistua dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyttävien ehdokkaiden määrää ei ole rajoitettu. Tarjoaja hakeutuu dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

buyer: УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКА МНОГОПРОФИЛНА БОЛНИЦА ЗА АКТИВНО ЛЕЧЕНИЕ "КАНЕВ" АД
title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – „Доставка на лекарствени продукти, които не са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, за нуждите на УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ“ АД
description: ДСП се създава за периодична доставка по предварителна заявка на лекарствени продукти, които не са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС по чл. 262, ал. 6, т. 2 от ЗЛПХМ, необходими за изпълнение на лечебната дейност в УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ” АД. Лекарствените продукти, предмет на процедурата са представени в първоначална "Техническа спецификация“ /част от документацията за участие/, с посочени лекарствени форми, количество лекарствено вещество, единица мярка и необходимо прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови лекарствени продукти и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към настоящите указания „Техническа спецификация“ са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Кандидатите, включени в ДСП могат да подадат оферта за един или повече редове, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на 36 /тридесет и шест/ месеца, като в този период Възложителят може да отправя покани до включените в ДСП кандидати за събиране на оферти за всяка конкретна поръчка за доставка на лекарствени продукти, в рамките на ДСП. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 месеца. ДСП функционира на два етапа, както следва: ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ: Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие в ДСП. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържат информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор, поставени от Възложителя. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 29.07.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие се извършва в срок до 10 /десет/ работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се включват в ДСП. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления, Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца /всеки понеделник от първата и третата седмица на месеца/. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията, Възложителят издава решение за подбор. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ: След влизане в сила на първоначалното решение за включване на одобрените кандидатите в ДСП, Възложителят обявява отделни процедури в рамките на ДСП. За всяка конкретна процедура, Възложителят изпраща покана за представяне на оферти за конкретната поръчка до всички кандидати, включени в ДСП. Офертите на кандидатите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще бъде достъпна и безплатна за участниците.

buyer: Kulttuurin ja vapaa-ajan toimiala, Helsingin kaupunki
title: EU-Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osallistumispyyntö: Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä 2024-2029 (DPS)
description: Helsingin kaupunki tulee kilpailuttamaan lapsille ja nuorille suunnatun harrastustoiminnan järjestämisen aikajaksolla elokuu 2025 – kesäkuu 2029 osana Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä hanketta. Tämän ajanjakson aikana julkaistaan useampia tarjouspyyntöjä. Kilpailutukset toteutetaan nyt perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän puitteissa. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kaksivaiheinen. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä ilmoittaudutaan mukaan ko. järjestelmään ja siinä tarkistetaan ehdokkaan soveltuvuus ja toisessa vaiheessa ehdokkaat voivat antaa tarjouksia tarjouskilpailuihin, jotka järjestetään DPS järjestelmän sisällä. Kaikki kelpoisuus- ja vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät toimittajat valitaan mukaan DPS:ään. Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä tarjoaa lasten ja nuorten toiveisiin perustuvia maksuttomia harrastuksia koulupäivän yhteydessä. Laadukkaat ja monipuoliset harrastukset toteutetaan koulujen tiloissa ja niiden lähiympäristössä. Kannustamme seuroja, järjestöjä, yrityksiä ja muita harrastusten tuottajia ilmoittautumaan mukaan harrastusten järjestäjiksi Helsingissä. title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Olanzapin (ausschl. Dafo. TRS), ATC N05AH03 für die Zeit 01.09.2026 - 31.08.2028 (zzgl. V.-Option 1x12 Mon)
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Olanzapin (ausschließlich Darreichungsform TRS), ATC N05AH03, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.09.2026 in Kraft und endet am 31.08.2028 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate). Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: RFSA - Provision of Hydrographic/Bathymetric production services.
description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT (NPP) This bid solicitation cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 30004518 dated August 29, 2024 with a closing of October 16, 2025 at 14:00 Atlantic Time. Submissions for 30004518 will no longer be accepted. This solicitation will remain on CanadaBuys until June 30, 2029. The Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement to establish a number of Supply Arrangement (SA) with pre-qualified suppliers to meet the general requirements specified in each of the following service streams: a. STREAM 1: Hydrographic/Bathymetric Training Services; b. STREAM 2: Hydrographic Navigational Charting Support and Production services; c. STREAM 3: Bathymetric Data Assessment and Processing services; and d. STREAM 4: Hydrographic/Bathymetric Consulting services. These services will be required on an as required basis throughout the period(s) of the Supply Arrangement. The Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) is mandated to chart Canadian waters to ensure safe navigation and to protect Canadian sovereignty. In that endeavour CHS must collect hydrographic/bathymetric data in support of new digital charting products as well as maintain existing portfolios of nautical charts in a variety of formats. This must be done using current international charting standards of data collection, processing and production. The proposed period of the Supply Arrangement is five (5) years from the date of issuance to December 31, 2029. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult Part 1 - General Information, and Part 6A - Supply Arrangement. For more information on personnel and organization security screening or security clauses, Suppliers should refer to the Contract Security Program of Public Works and Government Services Canada (http://www.tpsgc-pwgsc.gc.ca/esc-src/introduction-eng.html) website. The Request for Supply Arrangements (RFSA) is to establish supply arrangements for the delivery of the requirement detailed in the RFSA to the Identified Users across Canada, excluding locations within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, and Labrador that are subject to Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs). Any requirement for deliveries to locations within CLCAs areas within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, or Labrador will have to be treated as a separate procurement, outside of the resulting supply arrangements. To allow new suppliers to qualify, the Request for Supply Arrangement will be posted on the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) up to six (6) months prior to its expiry date.

title: Palo- ja Pelastuskalusto DPS 2025-2029
description: Lapin hyvinvointialue pyytää osallistumishakemuksia dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään (jäljempänä myös DPS). Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi hakea tarjoajaksi, jos täyttää soveltuvuusvaatimukset, jotka on ilmoitettu ESPD-lomakkeella ja kohdassa Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Lapin hyvinvointialueen pelastuslaitoksella on tarve erilaisille palo- ja pelastuskalustoilla. Tätä kalustoa varten perustetaan Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä jonka hankintajakso on 48 kuukauden pituinen. Järjestelmä jaetaan osiin. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on 975 000 euroa. Lapin hyvinvointialue ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin tai määräostovelvoitteisiin tällä ilmoituksella. Lapin hyvinvointialueella on oikeus tarvittaessa hankkia välineitä myös dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ulkopuolella, esimerkiksi erillisten kilpailutusten, suorahankintojen tai voimassa olevien sopimustensa perusteella. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa 30.6.2029 saakka, ellei sitä erillisellä ilmoituksella lyhennetä tai pidennetä., Pelastusvälineet Pelastusvälineillä tehdään tarvittavia muutoksia onnettomuusajoneuvoihin pelastustöiden yhteydessä. Tähän tarkoitukseen soveltuvia pelastusvälineitä ovat mm. levitin, leikkuri ja työntötanko. Muita soveltuvia työkaluja ovat mm. puukkosaha. Pelastusvälineitä hankitaan arviolta kaksi settiä vuodessa. Yleensä setti sisältää Levittimen, leikkurin, työntötangon, 6 akkua ja 3 laturia. Lisäksi osa-alue voi sisältää pelastusvälinesarjojen lisävarusteita ja varaosia. Tarkemmat vaatimukset määritellään kilpailutuskohtaisesti dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa., Nostotyynyt Nostotyynyillä tarkoitetaan tyynyjä, joilla voidaan nostaa ja tukea raskaita taakkoja. Nostotyynyjä hankitaan arviolta keskimäärin kaksi settiä vuodessa. Setillä tarkoitetaan kokonaisuutta, joka sisältää kolme erikokoista tyynyä ja näiden lisätarvikkeet, kuten letkut ja ohjaimet. Nostotyynyjä tarvitaan eri kokoluokan tyynyjä, sekä matala- ja korkeapainetyynyjä. Lisäksi osa-alue sisältää näihin tarvittavia lisävarusteita ja varaosia. Tarkemmat vaatimukset määritellään kilpailutuskohtaisesti dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa., Hyppytyynyt Pelastuskäyttöön tarkoitettuja hyppytyynyjä hankitaan arviolta keskimäärin kaksi vuodessa. Tyynyjä käytetään korkealta pelastamisen suojaksi. description: Срок на действие на ДСП (Етап 1): 36 (тридесет и шест) месеца, считано от датата на публикуване на обявлението в ЦАИС ЕОП. Срок на конкретните договори (Етап 2): Договорите, сключвани в изпълнение на конкретните покани (ограничени процедури) в рамките на системата, ще бъдат със срок на изпълнение 18 (осемнадесет) месеца. Прогнозната стойност на ДСП е изчислена за целия 36-месечен срок и включва предвиден финансов ресурс за обезпечаване на възникнали извънредни, специфични или нови медицински нужди на лечебното заведение. Включените в първоначалната Техническа спецификация (Приложение № 1) количества лекарствени продукти са ориентировъчни и покриват прогнозното потребление на Възложителя за първоначален период от 18 месеца. Възложителят си запазва правото при провеждането на всяка последваща конкретна поръчка (покана за оферти) на Етап 2 да променя и актуализира количествата, както и да добавя изцяло нови номенклатури (лекарствени продукти), съобразно реалните и актуални потребности на болницата, до достигане на общия финансов лимит на системата.

title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – ДОСТАВКА НА ЛЕКАРСТВЕНИ ПРОДУКТИ ЗА НУЖДИТЕ НА "МБАЛ - Д-Р АСЕН ВЕЛЕВ" ЕООД
description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове лекарствени продукти за нуждите на „МБАЛ – Д-Р АСЕН ВЕЛЕВ“ ЕООД. Посочените количества по Техническата спецификация са прогнозни и не пораждат задължения за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените лекарствени продукти, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. ДСП се провежда на два етапа. ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 12.08.2026 г. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията Възложителят издава решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се присъединяват към ДСП. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ След допускане до ДСП на кандидатите, подали заявление следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. За възлагане на поръчките във втория етап Възложителят обявява отделни ограничени процедури в рамките на ДСП!

title: Sweden – Sewage treatment works – DIS: Modernisering av VA SYD:s produktionsanläggningar
description: Upphandling av tvärfunktionella entreprenader som innehåller flera (minst två) olika tekniska delmoment för modernisering av VA SYD:s produktionsanläggningar. Detta är ett befintligt dynamiskt inköpssystem (DIS) avseende Modernisering av VA SYDs produktionsanläggningar. DISet har tidigare varit annonserat via Tendsign men då VA SYD bytt upphandlingsverktyg till Clira Esource, flyttas det nu över till det systemet. Det betyder att VA SYD inte kommer tillämpa den inledande 30 dagars ansökningstid som ska tillämpas vid införande av nya dynamiska inköpssystem. Ingen information från den ursprungliga annonseringen är justerad och tidigare kvalificerade entreprenörer kommer automatiskt att bli anslutna i Clira Esource.

ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based procurement contracts or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4002, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) In the event that an Other Transaction for Prototype agreement is awarded as a result of this competitive ARA, and the prototype project is successfully completed, there is the potential for a prototype project to transition to award of a follow-on production contract or transaction. title: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE FOR GATE HOIST MACHINERY PAINTING AND HOIST HOUSE REHABILITATION FOR FOX RIVER DAMS, WISCONSIN
description: ** This Pre-Solicitation Notice is being issued by the United States Army Corps of Engineers- Chicago District to inform interested vendors of the district?s intent to issue a solicitation for Gate Hoist Machinery Painting and Hoist House Rehabilitation for Fox River Dams, Wisconsin. ** ** PROJECT INFORMATION: The Government is seeking a contractor to 1) repaint the gate hoisting machinery and 2) to rehabilitate the gate hoist houses for 9 (nine) US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) operated dams on the Fox River, Wisconsin. The dams include the following: Kaukauna Dam, Little Chute Dam, Cedars Dam, Appleton Lower Dam, Menasha Dam, Appleton Upper Dam, DePere Dam, Little Kaukauna Dam, and Rapid Croche Dam.Base 1 repainting work includes surface preparation and painting of the various gate hoisting machinery located at each dam. Base 2 hoist houses rehabilitation work at each dam includes: (1) replacing the existing shingle roofing with metallic sheet roofing; (2) replacing current doors with heavy duty commercial doors (modify existing door wall framing as needed ISO heavier doors); (3) replacing exterior vinyl siding with galvalume siding; (4) replacing the exterior soffit fascia; and (5) insulating the ceiling and wall cavities.Material specifications and installation procedures will be in accordance with the USACE EM 385-1-1 requirements and procedures summarized in a scope of work. ** ** ACQUISITION INFORMATION: Competition for this acquisition is RESERVED EXCLUSIVELY for Small Business Concerns. The North American Industry System Classification Code is 236220, with a small business size standard in dollars of $45.0 Million. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. The requirement is for one (1) year. The solicitation package, bid opening, and award is planned for advertisement Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026. ** ** Prospective vendors can download the solicitation and related documents only from DoWs Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) system, once it is released. The PDF files can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. ** ** IMPORTANT POLICY: Contractors are REQUIRED to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) AT THE TIME ITS BID/PROPOSAL IS SUBMITTED, in orderto comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. Registration can be completed free of charge at www.sam.gov. Contractors also must register with sam.gov, prior to registering PIEE. Your firm must register with PIEE in order to access the solicitation and to place a bid/proposal in response to the upcoming USACE Solicitation. Use the PIEE System Registration link: ? https://piee.eb.mil and follow the instructions on their website. Request for Solicitation packages made by telephone, fax, or e-mail will not be honored. ** ** Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Strategic-Partnerships/Partnering/mod/129895/details/443/ then scrolling down on right hand side of page by clicking on ?View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here?. ** ** The Point of Contract for this acquisition is Ericka Hillard at ericka.d.hillard@usace.army.mil. ** ** Please include Solicitation number W912P626BA026 on all correspondence. **

description: Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is inviting contractors to apply to be placed on QRT source list(s) for work required by the Department of National Defence, at 22 Wing North Bay, Ontario. The source list will be in place until August 6, 2029. Applications will be accepted for the following category of service(s): General Contractors DCC may utilize QRTs for projects with an estimated value between $100,000 and $500,000. Contractors that want to join a QRT source list, must submit their application by e-mail using the Source List application form. Attention: Rowana Brown Email address:  NBContracting@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Application forms sent by fax or mail will not be accepted.  Interested contractors may request to join the SL at any time, subject to the SL terms and conditions. Upon receipt of a request, an administrative processing time of approximately 10 days is required to be included in this SL. However, DCC is requesting that interested contractors submit a request to join the SL as soon as possible, preferably by August 6, 2026. The language selected by the applicant for a QRT Source List will be the only language used for the tender documents, the contract documents and communication for all future tenders and during the execution of any resulting contract. The language selected will apply for the duration of the QRT Source List. This procurement is in accordance with the tendering procedures found in Chapter 5 of the Canadian Free Trade Agreement. Although a security clearance is not required to be added to a source list, contractors are advised that tenders and contracts under the QRT source list(s) may contain organization and personnel security requirements. Typically, the organization security requirement will be Designated Organization Screening (DOS) and reliability status for personnel. However more stringent requirement may apply such as Facility Security Clearance (FSC) at the level of SECRET with approved Document Safeguarding (DSC) with secret clearance for personnel. See the enclosed QRT Source List Terms and Conditions for additional information. Contracts put in place by DCC include measurable performance standards and requirements as detailed in form DCL81-Performance Evaluation Guidelines which is available at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. title: Justification for an Exception to Fair Opportunity Innovation Associates, Inc.
description: This JEFO is valid from the date of approval, July 21, 2025, through the conclusion of the period of performance, July 22, 2029. This is a Class JEFO for the purchase of annual pharmacy automation equipment maintenance service and support program under Innovation Associates, Inc.�s DLA Troop Support Patient Monitoring and Capital Equipment (PMCE) Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017. Annual maintenance coverage consists of equipment repair and software updates. Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017 was awarded under the PMCE Program solicitation SPE2D1-17-R-0001. This Class JEFO will apply to all Service Maintenance Agreement (SMA) orders placed under the subject contract commencing with the date of approval of the Class JEFO through July 22, 2029, when the five-year base and five-year option periods expire. Innovation Associates is the only vendor who can perform maintenance on its Innovation Pharmacy Workflow and Automation System, iA NEXiA, software and ensure the installed systems� performance and cybersecurity accreditation is maintained. Innovation is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and only source for the maintenance services required on the iA NEXiA units because they are the OEM with the sole proprietary license for the operating software. The iA NEXiA, formally known as PharmAssist, is an automated medication dispensing system for oral and solid medications with linked and computerized quality assurance software. The iA NEXiA system is integrated with the Composite Health Care System (CHCS) using digital imagery and bar code technology incorporated into the entirely paperless prescription filling process. The linked quality assurance software with digital images of prescriptions provides a significant safety measure by verifying accuracy for all prescriptions filled at various CHCS-hosted pharmacy sites against the original scanned hard copy prescription. The annual maintenance coverage provided by Innovation consists of equipment repair and software updates. Repairs include annual preventative maintenance (PM) and minor equipment adjustments due to wear and tear. Software updates can include but are not limited to updated drug lists and cyber security changes. The required software updates are proprietary to Innovation. Repairs of the iA NEXiA equipment often require interaction with the iA NEXiA proprietary operating software. Innovation Associates, is the sole manufacturer of the iA NEXiA and are capable of maintaining all system information security certifications, testing and on-going Information Assurance (IA), including security updates and patches. Accordingly, only Innovation Associates can maintain the Authority to Operate and the critical security status of the iA NEXiA systems on an ongoing basis under yearly maintenance programs. Security updates and patches must be thoroughly tested by the manufacturer prior to being applied to their system; therefore, only Innovation Associates can provide maintenance for their manufactured equipment.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Dynamisches Beschaffungssystem zur Beschaffung von verschiedenen IT-Dienstleistungen
description: Ziel des uni-assist e.V. ist, ein neues Service-IT-System zur Unterstützung der Zulassungsvorbereitung an deutschen Hochschulen zu entwickeln. Ausgehend von einer am Ende ihres Lebenszyklus angelangten proprietären Software (aBIS) und angesichts der sich beschleunigenden Digitalisierung der Zulassungsvorbereitung, dem weiter wachsenden Interesse internationaler degree seeker an einem Studium in Deutschland sowie dem zurzeit häufig beschriebenen Bedarf an (internationalen) Fachkräften in Deutschland 1 ist es für den Verein unabdingbar, zügig ein neues System zu etablieren, um (i) internationalen Studieninteressierten eine intuitiv und einfach nutzbare Plattform zur Einreichung ihrer Studienbewerbungen zur Verfügung zu stellen, (ii) den im Verein organisierten deutschen Hochschulen ein transparentes und faires Auswahlverfahren zu ermöglichen, (iii) die internen Bewertungsprozesse effizient und qualitativ hochwertig abzubilden und (iv) auf Basis der generierten Daten, Handlungsempfehlungen und Verfahrensoptimierungen für interne und externe Stakeholder*innen zu entwickeln. Zentrale Ziele der Neuentwicklung sind (i) die technologische sukzessive Ablösung des Alt-Systems, (ii) die Erhöhung des Automatisierungsgrads in den Verfahrensprozessen und (iii) die möglichst vollständige Digitalisierung der Prozesse bei (iv) gleichzeitiger Steigerung der Usability für die Nutzer*innen sowie (v) der Wahrung und Sicherstellung aller (datenschutz-) rechtlichen Normen. Dafür benötigt der AG die nachfolgenden IT-Dienstleistungen (Kategorie): 1. Unterstützung in der Softwareentwicklung (bspw. Programmieren, Steuern der Scrum-Teams, Testen) 2. Unterstützung des Anforderungsmanagements 3. Unterstützung in der Systemadministration 4. Unterstützung in Wahrung und Weiterentwicklung der IT- und Datenschutzsicherheit 5. Unterstützung in der Koordination des Softwareentwicklungsprojekts und Beratung der IT-Abteilung (bspw. PMO, Projektleitung, Agile Coaching, Datenmanagement)

Zentrale Ziele der Neuentwicklung sind (i) die technologische sukzessive Ablösung des Alt-Systems, (ii) die Erhöhung des Automatisierungsgrads in den Verfahrensprozessen und (iii) die möglichst vollständige Digitalisierung der Prozesse bei (iv) gleichzeitiger Steigerung der Usability für die Nutzer*innen sowie (v) der Wahrung und Sicherstellung aller (datenschutz-) rechtlichen Normen. Dafür benötigt der AG die nachfolgenden IT-Dienstleistungen (Kategorie): 1. Unterstützung in der Softwareentwicklung (bspw. Programmieren, Steuern der Scrum-Teams, Testen) 2. Unterstützung des Anforderungsmanagements 3. Unterstützung in der Systemadministration 4. Unterstützung in Wahrung und Weiterentwicklung der IT- und Datenschutzsicherheit 5. Unterstützung in der Koordination des Softwareentwicklungsprojekts und Beratung der IT-Abteilung (bspw. PMO, Projektleitung, Agile Coaching, Datenmanagement)

title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware
description: Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice ID: W50S6X26Q0008 Title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware NAICS Code: 541810 (Advertising Agencies) OR 541850 (Outdoor Advertising) 1. DISCLAIMER This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This notice is issued solely for market research and planning purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. It does NOT constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice; all costs associated with responding to this notice will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future competitive solicitation, if one is issued. 2. BACKGROUND & REQUIREMENT SUMMARY The 166th Mission Support Contracting is conducting market research to identify potential small business and socioeconomic contractors capable of providing a targeted vehicle-wrap advertising and brand ambassador campaign. The contractor shall provide fully wrapped vehicles that will operate in highly visible, targeted zones across Delaware (Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and Delaware Beach Towns). The core deliverables include: Fleet Branding: Ten (10) fully wrapped vehicles � complete coverage (doors, hood, trunk, and back windows), to include installation and de-installation. Targeting & Vetting: Sourcing drivers whose daily routes align with the specified target zones. Drivers must pass comprehensive background checks. Collateral Distribution: Distribution of up to 2,000 Government-provided brochures (approx. 200 per vehicle) by the drivers. Analytics & Reporting: Monthly reporting to include Proof of Performance photos, GPS tracking heat maps, mileage tracking, and verified impression counts to calculate overall campaign exposure. 3. REQUESTED INFORMATION / CAPABILITY STATEMENT Interested parties are requested to submit a Capability Statement (no more than 5 pages) addressing their ability to perform the services described above. Please include the following administrative information and answer the generic and specific capability questions below. A. Administrative & Company Information: Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email). Unique Entity ID (UEI) and CAGE Code. Business Size and Socioeconomic Status under NAICS 541810 (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB). Are these services available on an existing Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) or GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)? If yes, please provide the contract number. Are your services considered commercial under the definition provided in FAR 2.101? B. Capability Questions: Do you have an established network of local drivers operating within Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and the Delaware Beach Towns? How do you map and vet driver routes to ensure the wrapped vehicles are frequently operating in our specific target geographic areas? Are your drivers willing and contractually able to distribute physical promotional collateral (brochures) to passengers/the public, and how do you track their distribution compliance? What specific background checks (e.g., criminal, driving record) do you mandate for your drivers before campaign launch? Do you have the capability to provide monthly GPS heat maps and real-time mileage tracking of the wrapped vehicles? How do you calculate your impression metrics, and do you use an independent or third-party verification system for this data? 4. Pre-Solicitation Questions & Answers (Q&A) The following Anticipated Q&A is provided to assist interested parties in understanding the Government's requirement and the current market research phase. Q1: Is there an incumbent contractor currently performing these exact services? A1: No, this is a new requirement for the Government. Q2: Has a decision been made regarding a small business set-aside for this requirement? A2: No. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine the availability of capable small businesses (including 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, and WOSB). The Government will use the responses to this notice to make an informed decision on the acquisition strategy and any potential set-asides. Q3: Will the Government provide the 2,000 brochures/literature pieces, or is the contractor responsible for the printing costs? A3: The Government will provide the physical brochures/literature pieces to the contractor. The contractor is only responsible for the allocation and distribution of these materials via the campaign drivers. Q4: Does the Government require the vehicles to be dedicated solely to this campaign, or can they be active rideshare vehicles operating their normal routes? A4: The Government expects these to be active rideshare (or similar) vehicles operating their normal daily routes, provided those routes consistently overlap with the targeted geographic zones (Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and Delaware Beach Towns). Q5: Will the Government accept alternative advertising methods, such as public transit (buses/trains) or static billboards? A5: At this time, the Government is specifically researching the capability for wrapped rideshare/ambassador vehicles that allow for targeted geographic roaming and direct passenger collateral distribution. However, if a vendor believes an alternative approach meets the core intent and deliverables, they are welcome to detail that alternative in their Capability Statement. Q6: When does the Government anticipate releasing the official Request for Quote (RFQ) or Request for Proposal (RFP)? A6: The solicitation release date is currently To Be Determined (TBD) and is contingent upon the results of this market research and subsequent funding availability. 5. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Responses must be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Michael Palet Michael.palet.1@us.af.mil and the Contracting Officer Bryan.Driscoll.5@us.af.mil no later than 26 July 2026 at 2359 EST. Please include "Sources Sought Response: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - [Company Name]" in the email subject line. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted. Note: The Government will compile all submitted questions and post the answers publicly as an amendment to the Sources Sought notice on SAM.gov. Please do not include proprietary or confidential information in your questions

title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – „Доставка на лекарствени продукти, които са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, за нуждите на УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ“ АД“
description: „Доставка на лекарствени продукти, които са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, за нуждите на УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ“ АД“ ДСП се създава за периодична доставка по предварителна заявка на лекарствени продукти, които са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС по чл. 262, ал. 6, т. 2 от ЗЛПХМ, необходими за изпълнение на лечебната дейност в УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ” АД. Лекарствените продукти, предмет на процедурата са представени в първоначална "Техническа спецификация“ /част от документацията за участие/, с посочени лекарствени форми, количество лекарствено вещество, единица мярка и необходимо прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови лекарствени продукти и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към настоящите указания „Техническа спецификация“ са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Кандидатите, включени в ДСП могат да подадат оферта за един или повече редове, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на 36 /тридесет и шест/ месеца, като в този период Възложителят може да отправя покани до включените в ДСП кандидати за събиране на оферти за всяка конкретна поръчка за доставка на лекарствени продукти, в рамките на ДСП. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 месеца. ДСП функционира на два етапа, както следва: ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ: Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие в ДСП. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържат информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор, поставени от Възложителя. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 31.08.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие се извършва в срок до 10 /десет/ работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се включват в ДСП. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления, Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца /всеки понеделник от първата и третата седмица на месеца/. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията, Възложителят издава решение за подбор. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ: След влизане в сила на първоначалното решение за включване на одобрените кандидатите в ДСП, Възложителят обявява отделни процедури в рамките на ДСП. За всяка конкретна процедура, Възложителят изпраща покана за представяне на оферти за конкретната поръчка до всички кандидати, включени в ДСП. Офертите на кандидатите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще бъде достъпна и безплатна за участниците.

title: Germany – Asbestos-removal work – Asbestexposition bei Tätigkeiten an Putzen, Spachtelmassen und Fliesenklebern - Poolvereinbarung Sanierungsfachunternehmen (Open-House Verfahren)
description: ES HANDELT SICH UM EIN OPEN HOUSE VERFAHREN - ANGEBOTE SIND DAHER DAUERHAFT MÖGLICH - DIE ANGEBOTSFRIST IST AUF DIE FERNE ZUKUNFT GESETZT, UM DIES ZU ERMÖGLICHEN! Die Berufsgenossenschaften der Bauwirtschaft (BG Bau), Energie Textil Elektro Medienerzeugnisse (BG ETEM) sowie Holz und Metall (BGHM) (im Folgenden: die Berufsgenossenschaften) beabsichtigen im Rahmen des gemeinsamen Kooperationsprojektes ¿Asbestexposition bei Tätigkeiten an Putzen, Spachtelmassen und Fliesenklebern¿ verschiedene noch zu akquirierende Objekte im Hinblick auf die dort im Zusammenhang mit Bauarbeiten auftretende Asbestexposition zu untersuchen. Hierbei sollen parallel zu den eigentlichen (Bau-)Arbeiten am und im Objekt unter Einsatz spezieller Gerätesysteme tätigkeitsbegleitende Messungen erfolgen. Ziel des gemeinsamen Messprogramms ist die Ermittlung der Exposition von Beschäftigten gegenüber Asbest. Untersucht werden Tätigkeiten auf Baustellen beim sogenannten Bauen im Bestand, d.h. Tätigkeiten in Gebäuden die zwischen ca. 1960 und 1995 errichtet oder grundlegend modernisiert wurden. Die vorliegende Beschaffung betrifft einen Open-House-Vertrag deren Gegenstand die Beauftragung von Fachsanierern ist. Es handelt sich um ein sog. Open-House-Verfahren, d.h. nicht um ein klassisches Vergabeverfahren nach den vergaberechtlichen Regelungen, insbesondere der 4. Teil des GWB sowie die VgV sowie die VOB/A , bei dem der Auftraggeber die Auswahl des Auftragnehmers zu verantworten hat.
